Standard: Data and voice communication systems on the air vehicle required for AR are compatible with other systems, including the FCSs, and flight crew on both the air vehicle and the targeted air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of specifications verifies that data and voice communication systems are compatible with flight critical system on either air vehicle and do not present a hazard to flight crew. Analysis.
  (1) Electromagnetic environmental effects analysis verifies data and voice communication equipment required for AR does not interfere with other systems, including the FCSs, nor present a hazard to flight crew. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Laboratory testing of data and voice equipment verifies spectral characteristics which support E3 analyses.
